occasions: The danger lies in forgetting what we had. Or there is a shared daily life riddled with holes of silence.

occasionally: Even such sophisticated mammals as the great predator cats occasionally eat their cubs. A mother cat will be observed licking the area around the umbilical cord of the helpless newborn.
